ks128Loop:
		VMOV	R7, V2.S[0]
		VTBL	V3.B16, [V2.B16], V2.B16

		EORW	R13, R4
		LSLW	$1, R13           // Compute next Rcon

		CSELW	NE, R14, R13, R13 // Fake modulo
		SUBS	$1, R8

		EORW	R0, R4
		EORW	R4, R5
		EORW	R5, R6
		EORW	R6, R7
